journey_legs_nonneg_chk.name: journey_legs_nonneg_chk
journey_legs_nonneg_chk.value: ("journey_legs"."distance_m" is null or "journey_legs"."distance_m" >= 0) and ("journey_legs"."duration_s" is null or "journey_legs"."duration_s" >= 0)

places_owner_chk.name: places_owner_chk
places_owner_chk.value: ("places"."scope" = 'PERSONAL' and "places"."owner_id" is not null) or ("places"."scope" = 'CATALOG' and "places"."owner_id" is null)

visits_expense_chk.name: visits_expense_chk
visits_expense_chk.value: ("visits"."expense_minor" is null and "visits"."expense_currency" is null) or ("visits"."expense_minor" >= 0 and "visits"."expense_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')
